idiom.en: But being a twin isn't always plain sailing – an idiom meaning easy and problem-free.
idiom.zh: 但当双胞胎并不总是一帆风顺的——这是一个意为轻松且无问题（一帆风顺）的习语。

idiom.en: Or maybe look for idioms or jargon terms that are often used in your industry.
idiom.zh: 或者寻找在你所在的行业中经常使用的习语或行话。

idiom.en: Maybe it makes you seem strange. When it comes to idioms, focus on comprehension first.
idiom.zh: 这或许会让你显得很奇怪。说到习语，首先要专注于理解。

idiom.en: The idiom the blink of an eye means a very short period of time.
idiom.zh: 习语“眨眼之间”的意思是极短的一段时间。

idiom.en: The idiom, with all guns blazing, describes doing things with lots of energy and enthusiasm.
idiom.zh: 成语“大张旗鼓”，形容做事充满精力和热情。

identify.en: Yet people vary widely in their ability to identify, understand and manage emotional signals.
identify.zh: 然而，人们在识别、理解和管理情绪信号的能力上，却存在很大差异。

identify.en: Despite the countless expeditions launched to uncover the truth, Fawcett’s remains have never been identified.
identify.zh: 尽管为了揭开真相发起了无数次远征，Fawcett 的遗骸却从未被确认过。

identify.en: To diagnose means to identify a disease or health problem through medical examination.
identify.zh: 诊断的意思是通过医学检查来确定疾病或健康问题。

identify.en: A lot of people living in these territories genuinely identify as French.
identify.zh: 生活在这些领地中的许多人真心认同自己是法国人。

identify.en: And their cameras can now track and monitor and identify patterns.
identify.zh: 他们的摄像头现在可以追踪、监视和识别模式。

ideal.en: Feedback doesn’t have to come from a teacher, though that’s ideal.
ideal.zh: 反馈不一定非得来自老师，尽管那是理想情况。

ideal.en: As soon as you begin to posit an ideal, you then begin to compare yourself to that ideal.
ideal.zh: 一旦你开始提出一个理想，你就会开始拿自己与那个理想进行比较。

ideal.en: As soon as you begin to posit an ideal, you then begin to compare yourself to that ideal.
ideal.zh: 一旦你开始提出一个理想，你就会开始拿自己与那个理想进行比较。

ideal.en: On a different island, finches has had longer, more delicate beaks ideal for eating insects or cactus nectar.
ideal.zh: 在另一个不同的岛上，雀类拥有更长、更精致的喙，非常适合吃昆虫或仙人掌花蜜。

ideal.en: But Marie thinks this ideal dream can cause problems.
ideal.zh: 但玛丽认为这种理想化的梦想会引发问题。

identification.en: Something that's incredibly important in foraging is to know a hundred and ten percent if you can eat it – positive identification of the plant.
identification.zh: 在觅食中非常重要的一点是，要百分之百地确定是否可以食用——对植物进行准确识别。

identical.en: Wallace, working completely independently in Southeast Asia, had developed a theory almost identical to Darwin’s.
identical.zh: Wallace在东南亚完全独立地开展工作，也得出了几乎与Darwin相同的理论。

identical.en: Some of these places are legally almost identical to mainland France.
identical.zh: 其中一些地方在法律上几乎与法国本土完全相同。

identical.en: More uncommon are identical twins, who come from a single fertilised egg and share 100% of their genes.
identical.zh: 更少见的是同卵双胞胎，他们来自一个受精卵，共享100%的基因。

identical.en: The fossils were similar, but not identical to modern species.
identical.zh: 这些化石虽然相似，但与现代物种并不完全相同。

identical.en: In more recent times, they use almost identical language.
identical.zh: 在更近的时期，他们使用几乎完全相同的语言。

idleness.en: It was designed like this because it had a specific target in mind: the able-bodied man who was choosing idleness over work.
idleness.zh: 它的设计初衷是有特定目标的：那些宁愿游手好闲也不愿工作的身强力壮的男子。

idle.en: But the majority of people who actually ended up inside the workhouse were not idle young men.
idle.zh: 但实际上最终落入济贫院的大多数人并非游手好闲的年轻男子。

idle.en: What is the old line? If it flies, floats or fornicates. very nice way to change the final f very impressive that's the way i heard it okay i'm pretty sure it's fox but yeah yeah yeah i think that was uh maybe it was uh felix dennis okay who who had that quote yeah he said if it flies floats or fornick gets rented i think the last one was a little too it's wrong that he didn't have a family didn't have kids so you know he missed the big one um but yeah there are lots of bad ways to spend money uh i i believe in investment you know i don't believe in consumption uh yes you can you're born with a short housing position you close that out you got yourself a nice house um get yourself some help to free up your time so you're not doing uh things that other people can do better um treat people well you know always overpay and expect the best uh pay them like they're the best and then expect the best but overall i think a good use of money is to take risks and build things and do things that other people can't do align it with your own unique talents so you can keep delivering to the world i'm not going to sit idle i'm not going to retire that's a that's a waste of whatever time i have left on this earth and if i'm doing something i enjoy then i'm already in perpetual retirement because work is just a set of things you want to do that that you have to do that you don't want to do.
idle.zh: 那句老话怎么说来着？如果它会飞、会浮或会交配……把最后一个f换掉的方式很好，令人印象深刻。我听到的就是那样。好吧，我很确定是“fox”，但是的，是的，我想那是Felix Dennis，他有那句名言。是的，他说如果它会飞、会浮或会交配，就租吧。我想最后一个词有点太……他没有家庭，没有孩子，所以他错过了最重要的一点。但确实，花钱的坏方式有很多。我相信投资，我不相信消费。是的，你出生时处于住房短缺的状态，你解决了这个问题，给自己买了一套好房子。给自己找些帮手来腾出时间，这样你就不用做别人能做得更好的事情。善待他人，你知道，总是多付钱并期待最好的结果。像对待最好的人一样对待他们，然后期待最好的结果。但总的来说，我认为金钱最好的用途是承担风险，构建事物，做别人做不到的事情。把它与你独特的才能结合起来，这样你就可以继续为世界做出贡献。我不会坐以待毙，我不会退休，那是在浪费我在这地球上剩下的任何时间。如果我正在做我喜欢的事情，那么我就已经处于永久退休状态了，因为工作只是一系列你必须做但你不想做的事情。

ideology.en: The irony, of course, was that Mobutu wasn’t exactly consistent in his ideology.
ideology.zh: 当然，具有讽刺意味的是，蒙博托的意识形态其实并不那么一致。

ideology.en: There were two opposing ideologies facing each other across a line of concrete and barbed wire.
ideology.zh: 在一条由混凝土和带刺铁丝网构成的分界线上，有两个相互对立的意识形态在对峙。

ideology.en: The French Republican model, the ideology, the belief system behind France, emphasizes a few key ideas.
ideology.zh: 法兰西共和国的模式、意识形态以及法国背后的信仰体系，强调了几个核心理念。

ideology.en: Through newspapers and radio, film, even architecture, the Nazi regime changed people’s opinion and promoted its ideology.
ideology.zh: 通过报纸、广播、电影甚至建筑，纳粹政权改变了人们的观点并宣扬其意识形态。

ideology.en: And beyond ideology, there is, of course, political calculation.
ideology.zh: 除了意识形态之外，当然还有政治算计。

idiot.en: Or can you think of a moment when you were, well, an emotional idiot?
idiot.zh: 又或者，你能想起某个时刻，自己表现得，嗯，简直像个“情感白痴”吗？

idiot.en: It's an intellectual yet idiot. These are people who are overeducated and they deny like basic common sense.
idiot.zh: 它是指“知识分子但白痴”。这些人受过过度教育，却否定基本的常识。

idiot.en: But I didn't doubt myself in the way of somebody else knows better than me for me or that, you know, I'm an idiot or I'm not worthwhile or anything that I guess I had the benefit of I grew up with a lot of love, like the people around me love me unconditionally.
idiot.zh: 但我并没有这样怀疑过自己：觉得别人比我更懂我，或者觉得我是个笨蛋，或者我毫无价值，或者其他什么。我想我有一个优势，我在充满爱的环境中长大，周围的人无条件地爱我。
